vlcc.note: MEG weight solved from reported TCE: 10% in 2026Q2, 15% in 2026Q3. 12% adopted.

kernel.note: Fitted on 2024Q1-2026Q2 reported TCEs. VLCC 32/35 CV 5.1%; the fit is flat between b=30 and b=40. Suezmax 25/30 CV 6.1%; the free fit was 12/98 at CV 3.6% but a 98-day window lags badly in a fast market, so the physical parameters are used. Suezmax remains the weakest parameter in the model.

coverage.note: Back-tested across 17 quarters of disclosure: implied k ranges -0.055 to +0.591, mean 0.297, median 0.275. 0.27 is effectively the median. The Q3-26 output is insensitive to it: $135k-$148k across the entire historical k range.

required_yields.note: 0.24 is not an assumption. On 28 August 2026, the day the slide was published, FRO closed at $41.40 against the slide's own $10.35 base-case FCF/share - a 25.0% cap rate. 24% sits a point inside that.

coverage_estimate.note: Share of a quarter's REMAINING days already fixed, so covered = elapsed + phi * (1 - elapsed). Solved from all 18 disclosures: every quarterly report states next-quarter coverage, and each lands 51-60 days into that quarter (mean 56.7). phi is the full-sample mean. The last five quarters average 0.586 and phi correlates +0.45 with the contracted rate, but the regression (R2 0.31) returns phi 1.62 when fed today's spot - four times outside its fitted range - so the recent regime is not extrapolable and the full sample is used. phi is observed only at day ~57 and is assumed flat across the quarter; it likely rises toward 1 near quarter end, which would make this an overstatement early in a quarter.

nav.note: Needs fleet.csv (vessel, segment, build year) and a broker value curve. Xclusiv VLCC assessments 18 Sep 2026: 5yr $172m, 10yr $152m, 15yr $135m; newbuild ~$131-135m. Early July for comparison: $145m / $115m / $83.5m. The age curve has collapsed - buyers paying for immediate availability. Frontline's Euronav tonnage skews old, so NAV is levered to the end of the curve that moved most.
